title: Ore Assembler
description: Minecraft mod that adds an Ore Assembler.
body:
Custom block.

The Ore Assembler can assemble multiple ores to create new ones.
He can be craft using 7 Smooth Stones, gold ingot and a diamond.

Crafts available are :

Diamond + Gold Ingot = Netherite Ingot.

Iron Ingot + Gold Ingot = Diamond.

Copper Ingot + Iron Ingot = Gold Ingot.

WARNING ! This is not a crafter ! Ores are assembled, at the moment you put them, the craft is done ! 


Hope y'all enjoy it
